# Prolific Studio

> > Prolific Studio is a professional animation production company specializing in 2D/3D animation, medical visualization, explainer videos, and game art across multiple studio locations.

Founded by David Lucas, Prolific Studio delivers custom animation services including medical animation for healthcare and biotech, commercial explainer videos, motion graphics, and game development art. The studio operates locations in Austin and Atlanta, serving clients across entertainment, healthcare, technology, and gaming industries.
